descriptions.notStarted: Alcaster says he has something for Snow Spirit.
descriptions.inProgress: He handed me a reply letter to Snow Spirit, a note that contains the exact method we should take to defeat Scrooge. I better go see her right now!
descriptions.completed: I gave the Snow Spirit Alcaster's reply letter. She stood quietly for a moment, then gave me something called Force of the Spirit, which she said was the key to defeating Scrooge. What exactly is this?
